title: Aromatic Umami Mexican Poblanos Stew
description: This stew is a flavorful and aromatic Mexican dish featuring roasted poblanos, ground annatto, and dashi extract, cooked to perfection in a claypot. It is a nut-free-friendly option for a delicious dinner.
instructions: Heat the claypot over medium heat and add the chopped onion, cooking until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until it is no longer pink.
Stir in the ground annatto, dashi extract, salt, and black pepper, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the roasted and chopped poblanos, canned diced tomatoes, and beef broth, stirring to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
